metric_definitions.WAPE: sum absolute error / sum absolute actual; fraction, null if zero denominator

target_definition: Distinct MAIN IBTrACS SIDs with NI tropical (TS) positions; includes depressions, counted in first qualifying month.

source.license_access_terms: NOAA IBTrACS metadata: redistribution/use without restriction; cite Gahtan et al. 2024, DOI 10.25921/82ty-9e16 and Knapp et al. 2010. NOAA ERDDAP official license metadata verified.
transformation_history: Unmodified public download; stored separately from original raw collection.

dataset_provenance.target: Count of distinct MAIN SIDs with a North Indian basin tropical (NATURE=TS) record, assigned to their first such month. Includes tropical depressions; no wind threshold or landfall definition.
dataset_provenance.zeros: Explicit zero eligible archived storm IDs in an included calendar month. Not verified absence of all cyclones/disasters.
dataset_provenance.excluded: Pre-1980, 2025/2026 incomplete/provisional years, non-main tracks, non-NI positions, non-TS positions. First qualifying month determined before date filtering to avoid counting cross-year storms twice.
dataset_provenance.geography: NI basin, not Indian political territory or district landfalls.

metrics.selection: Lowest mean_poisson_deviance on validation only; test never selects method.

leakage.cutoff_feature_rule: Only calendar fields for cyclone counts; only observed past annual exposure prefixes for PM2.5. No contemporaneous/future weather, impact or tourism features.
leakage.geographic_holdout: NOT_APPLICABLE: one basin or one country; no geographic generalization claim.
leakage.publication_time_vintages: UNAVAILABLE: revised-vintage retrospective experiment, not simulated historical availability.

metrics.classification_metrics: NOT_APPLICABLE: count/continuous regression; no fabricated binary negative labels or calibrated probabilities.

limitations: North Indian Ocean basin only; not India-wide multi-hazard risk, Indian landfall probability or district warning.
Zero counts describe this archive, not verified absence of all real-world events. No binary disaster negatives are manufactured.
Revised best tracks through 2024; publication-time vintages are unavailable. Retrospective scores do not establish operational forecasting.
No rainfall, future weather, severity, fatalities or post-event impact predictors; only known calendar fields.
No calibrated probability or uncertainty intervals. Forecasts start in 2025, not current 2026.
